text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon splendidly succeeded in delivering results in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

It was one day while basking in the afterglow
of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, let us play a staring contest.
Upon asking for more details――

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Looking back through the data from these past three years, I realized just how many things I have learned.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Especially on an emotional level: "happy," "frustrated," "I want to win"... and so on.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I learned many emotions
from running in races in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And then,
a certain question crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Not just in races, but in any competition,
there might be factors that evoke all sorts of emotions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: And so, I've prepared a 'staring contest' that I'm confident I can face Master on equal footing with.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Would you like to play a "staring contest"?
Once I gave my tentative agreement—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, with the loser having to do three laps
around the neighborhood on their hands, let's begin.

I can't let it happen,
nor can I do it myself.

Hoping to win and avoid the penalty game,
she pulled the funniest face she could muster!
Before long, the sun began to dip, yet the contest remained undecided—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue detected from Master.
...Are you alright?
choice_data_list: My face is gonna cramp up...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master's crisis identified.
It is necessary to conclude the match immediately.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Doing three laps around the neighborhood on my hands is a bit steep, but even so—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master. The match is over.
It is my defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Competitions truly are mysterious, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Even though it ended like that, I feel as though a new feeling has been born inside me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Besides, there was something I was able to reaffirm.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Doing things together with Master is,
after all... "fun."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Training, mountain climbing, racing...
It was all "fun."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm heading off to the edge of town.
I'll be back home in time for training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, the punishment game must be carried out—

—At any rate,
the days of striving toward further challenges alongside Mihono Bourbon would continue on!
